cited_by.title: Low haemoglobin, low or high white cells: causes, thresholds and pregnancy

record.population: Laboratory review of raised white cell counts
record.finding: The next steps for a raised white cell count depend on which cell types are raised and what a blood smear shows. Blasts on the smear are concerning for acute leukaemia. Many raised counts are reactive; the review lists reactive conditions and malignancies as separate groups.
